# Copilot Instructions Index

This is the canonical index for all Copilot-related instruction files in the repository.

- Every Copilot automation, prompt, or custom instruction must have a canonical file in `.github/instructions/copilot/`.
- Use this index to discover, update, or cross-reference Copilot workflows, chat modes, and prompt authoring.
- For org-wide Copilot guidance, see [custom-instructions.md](../custom-instructions.md).
